set_ship_text.name: Formidable Mission
set_ship_text.desc: Budron mining operation, apparently focused on transporting large volumes of dihydrogen monoxide gasses.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: Station is completely filled with phosphorous water.
set_ship_text.hailtext: We are not permitted to speak to you, strangers.

set_ship_text.hailtext: We are not permitted to speak to you, strangers.

set_ship_text.name: Reservoir
set_ship_text.desc: Station purpose-built to hold immense volumes of water ice and evaporate it into space.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: Trace analysis indicates that the water was largely sourced from the planet Disentis.^It also contains traces of flavor compounds associated with Budron holy individuals.
set_ship_text.hailtext: Please respect our full authority in these waters, as the Prophecy foretold.

set_ship_text.name: Watchful Eye
set_ship_text.desc: Some manner of overseeing station. Exact purpose unknown.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: Station is equipped with advanced sensing equipment.
set_ship_text.hailtext: Please respect our full authority in these waters, as the Prophecy foretold.

set_ship_text.name: Communion
set_ship_text.desc: Hull design matches with known Budron temple station architecture.^No activity detected. Station appears derelict.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: No life signs. No phosphorous water aboard station detected. Station is uninhabitable to Budrons.^^Nearby space contains traces of flavor compounds associated with Budron holy individuals.

set_ship_text.name: Flow Control
set_ship_text.desc: Administrative station and border control at Burin Gate.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: Station may have moderate defensive capabilities.
set_ship_text.hailtext: Please respect our full authority in these waters, as the Prophecy foretold.

set_ship_text.name: Hunk
set_ship_text.desc: Large asteroid, primarily comprised of water-ice. Slowly outgassing water vapor into space, creating a high concentration of dihydrogen monoxide gasses in the region.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: Anchoring points detected on the surface. This object was likely brought here from somewhere else.

set_ship_text.name: SAND-PLANETDisentis
set_ship_text.desc: Arid sand planet. Scans indicate 86% of the planet's surface used to be covered in water or water-ice.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: Detected mining installation on the surface, likely used to bring large volumes of water into space.
set_ship_text.hailtext: Please respect our full authority in these waters, as the Prophecy foretold.

set_ship_text.name: DEATHSTAR*UNKNOWN*
set_ship_text.desc: The object radiates infrared energy. Spectroscopic analysis results suggest a profile similar to a class of stellar object known as an iron star. Hawking radiation detected towards the poles. Gravity at surface: 25G. Invulnerable to conventional weaponry. Deep scan recommended.
set_ship_text.scan_desc: DATABASE MATCH: Caltron artifact, originally discovered 71023-2240 in Vilnara asteroid belt, titled 'Iron Moon'. [see: Zu Chongzhi et al].^^Artifact was later recognized by Budron contacts as a holy artefact of their culture, seized by Budron delegates, and hyperjumped to an unknown location.
